publication: The target-owned checkpoint validator reopens all 18 BF16 shards for every selected chunk before the first GPU-capable subprocess. Every to-be-created final campaign namespace, any needed fresh BF16 namespace, and both authority-map paths are rejected with lstat/lexists semantics, including dangling symlinks. Campaign directories are evidence, not publication; there is no in-place resume or mutation of a partial directory. The six-entry authority map binds the validated selected-chunk authority path and starting hash, is validated into a pending regular file, rechecks that selection hash immediately before publication, and is atomically published last by an exclusive same-directory hard link that cannot replace an existing name.
